result.title: Everyone Can Build a Robot: Open Source Embodied AI With Seeed Studio | NVIDIA AI Podcast Ep. 300
result.description:
What happens when you give an AI agent a physical body? Seeed Studio connected OpenClaw to a robot arm — and it found its own libraries, read the instructions, and started moving.

Eric Pan, CEO, and Elaine Wu, Head of Robotics at Seed Studio, explain how open-source robot arms — starting at $200 — running on NVIDIA Jetson can now be controlled through plain-text commands, and why the future of physical AI will be built by millions of developers, not just robotics experts.

🎧 Listen to the episode: https://youtu.be/C3lcadfxTio?si=ra1DDfCgwn0CJ5KG
